depiction.primary_object: three stacked horizontal bars representing lines of text
modifiers: solid circle badge with lowercase letter i in upper right
depiction.composition: horizontal lines on lower left overlapped by a circular badge at upper right

readings.meaning: stack of coins with info badge

ambiguity: The three thick horizontal bars can resemble a stack of coins or database layers, and at very small sizes the lowercase 'i' inside the circle can be misread as an exclamation mark (!).

modifier_semantics.meaning: information, details, about, help, or documentation

reasoning: The icon combines horizontal text lines with an 'i' information badge, signifying item details, descriptions, documentation, or a summary sheet. It fits tasks centered on writing or reviewing READMEs, product descriptions, house info sheets, and metadata, though at small sizes the 'i' badge can look like an alert '!' and the thick bars can resemble stacked coins.
